values.note: The campground's booking page: 'Walk-in Registrations are not permitted. Advance Reservations can be made same day up until 2 pm on date of arrival', and up to 4 months before arrival. Limited to 14 cumulative days in any one park between Memorial Day and Labor Day. Check-in 1-9 p.m., check-out by 11 a.m. From October 15-23 it operates Thursday-Sunday nights only. No visitors; registered campers only.

booking.source: https://massdcrcamping.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MA&parkId=32608 (alerts, Booking Window 'Reservations can be made up to 4 Month(s) prior to your arrival date', Reservation and Occupancy), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 29 RV/trailer sites (10 STANDARD ELECTRIC, 19 STANDARD NON ELECTRIC) among 86 bookable units; the rest are 50 tent-only sites, 6 yurts and a group site (the description says 91 sites). Listed max vehicle lengths 20-40 ft; the electric sites are 32 ft.

summary: Confirmed fees ($17 MA / $54 non-resident, +$6 electric) and the $4.50 transaction fee on the campground's booking page; season already manual (open to 10/25, Thu-Sun only 10/15-23). Confirmed the inherited no-walk-ins, 2 p.m. same-day cutoff, 4-month window and 14-day summer limit for this campground. Added 50-amp (20/30/50) electric, 29 RV sites to 40 ft, showers, dump. The page does not state the 2-day minimum (left inherited; AWH's firsthand note already says it was not enforced).
flags: waterfront re-audit lead (curation rule #7): the entry is 'not waterfront' with no waterfront_evidence, but the ReserveAmerica catalog marks 14 sites in loop 'Sites 59-90' as Waterfront: 61, 63, 69, 71, 75, 77, 81, 83, 87 (STANDARD, RV-capable, 25-40 ft) and 65, 67, 73, 79, 85 (tent).
